newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD LONG JUMP CHAMPION PEDROSO.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD LONG JUMP CHAMPION PEDROSO.

text.p: Profile of world long jump champion Ivan Pedroso:
Jumped world record 8.96 metres in 1995 at high altitude in Sestriere, Italy, but the mark was not ratified because of allegations that an official had been standing in front of the wind gauge.
Won the world title that year in Gothenburg.
Underwent hamstring surgery in March, 1996, and finished 12th of the Atlanta Olympics.
Bounced back in the indoor season, jumping 8.60 metres, the second longest indoor mark behind Carl Lewis's 8.79.
